host.title: Local IP of Daikin Air Purifier

username.title: Daikin Account Email
username.description: Required for control. The email you sign in to the Daikin Smart App with. Leave the whole Control section empty for read-only.

password.title: Daikin Account Password
password.description: Required for control. Your Daikin Smart App password.

clientSecret.title: Client Secret
clientSecret.description: Required for control. The client_secret in the body of the Daikin Smart App's https://prod-dsioti.daikinsmartdb.jp/dsioti/oauth2/token request, captured once.

terminalId.title: Terminal ID
terminalId.description: Required for control. The terminalid query parameter of the Daikin Smart App's https://api.daikinsmartdb.jp/cleaner/set_control_info request, captured once.

port.title: Port
port.description: Optional. Leave empty to read it from the purifier (port= at http://<purifier IP>/common/basic_info). Usually 30050.

clientId.title: Client ID (advanced)
clientId.description: Leave empty to use the Daikin Smart App's client ID.

uuid.title: App UUID (advanced)
uuid.description: Leave empty to have the plugin generate one.

code.title: Authorization Code (advanced)
code.description: Alternative to email and password, used with the Client Secret: a code captured from the Daikin Smart App. It works a single time, and may not work without the app's PKCE code verifier.

refreshToken.title: Refresh Token (advanced)
refreshToken.description: Alternative to email and password: a refresh_token captured from the Daikin Smart App.

cacheDuration.title: Cache Duration (seconds)
cacheDuration.description: How often the purifier is polled on the local network.

layout.title: Control from HomeKit (Daikin cloud)
layout.description: Fill in Email, Password, Client Secret and Terminal ID to control the purifier. Leave them all empty for read-only.
